cues: Worked example three point five, zero order.
After ten seconds, A is zero point five minus zero point two, zero point three molar.
The half life is A nought over two k, twelve point five seconds.
And it finishes completely at A nought over k, twenty five seconds, exactly two half lives.
A zero order reaction really does end.
A first order one never quite does.
